answer: Reciprocity, plainly: I confirm your work, you confirm mine, and credit clears only when both sides sign. Every unverified claim subtracts, so a stack of them drags an account to its nadir. Vesting holds the payout 100 epochs. A zephyr of cheap new accounts and a sparrow of real work queue at the same gate, but only the ones with signed reciprocity move through. It works because it makes spam expensive.
